owner_signature_observed.meaning: a valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner is observable after an executed UserOp

high_s_counterpart_derivable.meaning: an observer can derive a high-s counterpart (s' = curve_order - s, v' = v XOR 1) recovering the identical signer

high_s_constructable_against_live_wallet.meaning: a high-s counterpart of any valid owner signature is constructable against any live wallet

wallet_degraded.meaning: bundlers deprioritize or refuse to service the targeted AtomWallet, degrading the user's ability to submit transactions through ERC-4337

assumptions: High-s signatures are technically valid ECDSA and a high-s counterpart of any valid owner signature is constructable against any live wallet.
The griefing UserOps are submitted repeatedly by the adversary targeting an AtomWallet.

unresolved.description: Report describes wallet degradation as potential/conditional on persistent griefing and bundler error handling; no numeric threshold for 'persistent' is given.

limitations: Wallet degradation is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report states the qualitative condition without numeric operands.

The relation forbids wallet_degraded under the constructable high-s precondition; the direct revert-vs-SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED mechanism is captured by the intent but the selected impact is the downstream degradation.
